summary: The authorization and exact current document hashes are sound, and the staff architecture, local-first scope, and first-increment concept are generally coherent. Four changes are required before implementation: enforce the early bridge security/recovery gate, make monitoring and clean-build evidence explicit, hold persistence on unresolved storage/retention choices and distinguish synthetic from real runtime proof, and add an independent final product acceptance review.

open_findings.finding: The current sequence permits real host/core conversation before early S-08 channel security, deny admission and recovery prerequisites.
open_findings.required_change: Move bootstrap/Origin/Host/WS security, minimum deny admission and applicable S-01/S-09 evidence before any real browser-triggered SDK mutations; keep the first slice synthetic until they pass.

open_findings.finding: The build command alone does not prove local monitoring, redaction, backup/migration/rollback, clean-install or browser/bridge bundle isolation; generic Nx target success may omit targets or be cached.
open_findings.required_change: Require an explicit target inventory, frozen-lockfile clean install, bundle/boundary inspection, S-01–10 evidence and operational drills; map those checks to AC-6. Missing targets and cached stateful checks cannot satisfy acceptance. Include format and hooks or a justified applicability record.

open_findings.finding: Storage location, local retention policy and supported runtime/platform details remain open; synthetic adapter evidence could be mistaken for real SDK readiness.
open_findings.required_change: Hold persistent user-data behavior until storage location and retention are confirmed. Record an evidence matrix separating synthetic, actual local SDK/effect and credential-dependent runtime proof; missing live evidence keeps dependent acceptance incomplete.

open_findings.finding: Finalization does not assign an independent product reviewer to the implemented PRD acceptance groups and integrated scenarios.
open_findings.required_change: Add a fresh product_reviewer against the frozen implementation/evidence packet before declaring product completion.

provenance.routing_basis: coordinator-selected under standing user preference for planning and independent review
